words.defn_en: a unit of digital data equal to 1,024 bytes, or roughly one thousand bytes:
words.root_note: kilo- (one thousand) + byte (unit of digital data)

sentences.en: To save space on the retro gaming console, the programmer had to reduce the file size by one ______.
sentences.zh: 為了節省復古遊戲機上的空間，程式設計師必須將檔案大小縮減一個千位元組。

sentences.en: A simple plain text document requires only a single ______ of storage space.
sentences.zh: 一個簡單的純文字檔案只需要一個千位元組的儲存空間。

words.defn_en: the standard metric unit of mass equal to 1,000 grams:

sentences.en: The airline agent warned the passenger that her suitcase was one ______ over the weight limit.
sentences.zh: 航空公司人員警告乘客，她的行李超重了一公斤。

sentences.en: The recipe for the industrial adhesive required exactly one ______ of raw polymer powder.
sentences.zh: 這種工業黏著劑的配方需要精確的一公斤聚合物原料粉末。

words.defn_en: a metric unit of length equal to 1,000 meters, or about 0.62 miles:

sentences.en: The exhausted runner pushed forward, knowing that the finish line was just one ______ away.
sentences.zh: 疲憊不堪的跑者繼續向前推進，因為他知道終點線只剩下一公里遠了。

sentences.en: The hiking path follows a deep canyon that stretches for over a ______ through the mountains.
sentences.zh: 這條健行步道沿著一條深邃的峽谷延伸，在山脈中綿延超過一公里。

words.defn_en: a unit of electrical power equal to 1,000 watts:

sentences.en: The homeowner installed a five-______ solar array to generate electricity at peak sunlight.
sentences.zh: 屋主安裝了一組五千瓦的太陽能板，以在日照高峰期發電。

sentences.en: The appliance draws about one ______ of power while it is operating.
sentences.zh: 這部電器運作時大約消耗一千瓦的功率。

words.defn_en: a unit of data transmission speed equal to 1,000 baud:
words.defn_zh: 千波特（數據傳輸速率單位）
words.root_note: kilo- (one thousand) + baud (signal changes per second)

sentences.en: In the early days of dial-up internet, modems operated at a slow ______ rate that made downloading pictures frustrating.
sentences.zh: 在早期撥接上網的時代，數據機以極慢的千波特速率運作，這讓下載圖片變得令人沮喪。

sentences.en: The engineer adjusted the signal transmitter to a stable ______ rate to avoid data corruption.
sentences.zh: 工程師將信號發射器調整至穩定的千波特速率，以避免數據損壞。

words.defn_en: a unit of energy equal to 1,000 calories, commonly used to measure food energy:

sentences.en: An average adult requires roughly two thousand ______s per day to maintain a stable weight.
sentences.zh: 一般成年人每天大約需要兩千大卡的熱量來維持穩定的體重。

sentences.en: The nutritional label indicated that a single serving of the chocolate bar contained 250 ______s.
sentences.zh: 營養標籤顯示，這款巧克力棒單次食用量含有 250 大卡的熱量。

words.defn_en: a unit equal to 1,000 tons, or a measure of explosive power equal to 1,000 tons of TNT:
words.defn_zh: 千噸；千噸級爆炸威力單位
words.root_note: kilo- (one thousand) + ton (unit of weight or explosive force)

sentences.en: The historic explosion released energy equivalent to several ______s of TNT, flattening the test site.
sentences.zh: 這場歷史性的爆炸釋放了相當於數千噸 TNT 的能量，將測試場地夷為平地。

sentences.en: The massive cargo ship carried a total load of over fifty ______s of iron ore across the ocean.
sentences.zh: 這艘巨型貨輪運載了總計超過五萬公噸的鐵礦砂橫渡大洋。
